name: Ain't No Telling
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Who do you think you are? Showing up and sticking your nose in official business.

I'm not telling some rookie anything about the higher-up's dealings without good reason. Unless you've got something important, or valuable, for me, I've got nothing to say to you.
narrative.objectives: Find something within Stromgarde Keep to convince Anastasia to give up details of the secret deal.
